verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a dedicated MCP server (jitsu.com/docs/mcp, use.jitsu.com/mcp) explicitly for AI agents to create destinations, wire streams, inspect Live Events, and edit Functions, backed by OAuth 2.1 auth and API-key auth for headless use, plus a public Management API with OpenAPI reference and a jitsu-cli that mirrors UI capabilities. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the MCP server in practice (only vendor docs/blog), and the OpenAPI spec file itself 404s on probe despite being referenced.
